versions.changelog:
Initial release — visual identity specification template for consistent game art direction.

- Defines a modular art bible structure with sections for style guides, color palettes, character/environment/UI rules, and technical constraints.
- Provides step-by-step prompts for specifying visual style, influences, mood adjectives, color strategies, and palette standards.
- Includes structured templates for documenting asset guidelines, naming conventions, and export settings.
- Offers cross-platform notes and suggestions for AI and editor tool usage.
- Ensures complete visual reference and technical alignment for game art teams.
